address: ABC Brickworks Market & Food Centre, #01-141, Blk 6 Jalan Bukit Merah, 150006, Singapore
bio: Eight kinds of MSG-free slow-boiled soups, including the signature ginseng Silkie chicken soup that boasts a mild herbal taste are on the menu here. All are served with pumpkin rice or steamed rice. Come early to beat the crowds....
